dependency_conditions.reason: A valid National Identity Card is required to apply for a passport. If your NIC is lost or damaged, complete the duplicate NIC process first.

steps.title: Confirm you hold a valid NIC
steps.description: Your National Identity Card number must be valid and the card available. If lost, obtain a duplicate NIC first.

steps.title: Prepare your birth certificate
steps.description: An original birth certificate is required as supporting proof of identity and citizenship.

steps.title: Obtain passport-size photographs
steps.description: Provide colour photographs taken against a white background meeting the published specification (35mm x 45mm).

steps.title: Fill the passport application form (Form K-35-A)
steps.description: Complete the official application form. It must be certified by an authorised officer (e.g. Grama Niladhari).

steps.title: Pay the application fee
steps.description: Pay the applicable normal or one-day service fee at the bank counter or online portal.

steps.title: Submit your application
steps.description: Submit in person at Head Office (Battaramulla) or a Regional Office, or use the online appointment system.

steps.title: Track your application status
steps.description: Track the issuance status and collect the passport once processing is complete.
